papers.title: AREX: Towards a Recursively Self-Improving Agent for Deep Research
papers.abstract: Deep research requires agents to find answers satisfying multiple constraints. AREX alternates between research loops gathering evidence and self-improvement loops auditing answers, learning autonomous context compression.

papers.title: ReferTrack: Referring Then Tracking for Embodied Visual Tracking
papers.abstract: Introduces referring-then-tracking paradigm for embodied visual tracking using single RGB camera. Achieves state-of-the-art success rates on benchmarks with real-world deployment on legged and humanoid robots.

papers.title: Visual Contrastive Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: VCSD converts image-content removal into on-policy self-distillation signals, achieving improvements without external teachers or privileged signals across vision-language models of various scales.

papers.title: K12-KGraph: A Curriculum-Aligned Knowledge Graph for Benchmarking and Training Educational LLMs
papers.abstract: Introduces curriculum-aligned knowledge graph extracted from textbooks with 23,640-question benchmark and training data for evaluating and training educational LLMs on curriculum cognition tasks.

papers.title: Show, Don't Tell: Evaluating Spatial Cognition in Generative Pixels Rather Than LLM Text
papers.abstract: ProVisE framework elicits visual answers from image-generation models for spatial reasoning tasks. Reveals complementary strengths: image models excel in pixel-space spatial expression while text VLMs lead in compositional reasoning.

papers.title: Color Pass-Through via Camera-Display Coupling
papers.abstract: End-to-end learned framework treating camera and display as coupled system rather than isolated stages. Achieves +2.0 points on user study and 2x improvement on metrics for color reproduction.

papers.title: Tencent WorkBuddy Bench: A Multi-Domain Coding-Agent Benchmark with Contamination-Resistant Task Construction
papers.abstract: Multi-domain evaluation suite for coding agents across Code, Web, Office, and Security domains with contamination-resistant task construction methodology and cross-model leaderboard.

papers.title: LLMs Get Lost in Evolving User Intent
papers.abstract: Framework transforming static tasks into dynamic conversations where user intent evolves. Reveals strong static-setting performance doesn't transfer to evolving-intent settings across model families.

papers.title: SANA-Video 2.0: Hybrid Linear Attention with Attention Residuals for Efficient Video Generation
papers.abstract: Hybrid video diffusion transformer combining gated linear attention with periodic softmax anchors. Achieves competitive quality with 3.2x speedup and 120x acceleration with full-stack optimization.

papers.title: Self-Supervised Learning of Structured Dynamics from Videos
papers.abstract: Proposes SDM separating camera motion from object motion through future-feature prediction. Demonstrates pretrained image models can become structured video-dynamics representations with weak supervision.

cc_updates.body: Added Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5), now the default Opus model — 1M context, fast mode at $10/$50 per Mtok. Added sandbox.network.strictAllowlist setting to deny non-allowlisted hosts for sandboxed commands without prompting. Added DirectoryAdded hook that fires after /add-dir or the SDK register_repo_root control request registers a new working directory mid-session. Added mcp_server_errors to the headless stream-json init event. Added nested subagent forwarding in stream-json. Fixed claude -p text output dropping the answer already produced when a turn dies on a mid-stream API error. Added HTTP status and error text to claude mcp list and /mcp when a server fails to connect.

Changed /code-review to run as a background subagent, so review work no longer fills your conversation and keeps stacked slash commands as its review target. Added screen-reader announcements of deleted text for word and line deletions in --ax-screen-reader mode. Fixed Windows paths with u-prefixed segments being corrupted into CJK characters in tool inputs. Fixed the left arrow key discarding the conversation with no undo.

Added emoji shortcode autocomplete in the prompt input: type :heart: to insert heart emoji — disable with emojiCompletionEnabled setting. Added warnings when transcript writes are failing or when session saving is off. Fixed a memory leak where truncated MCP tool outputs kept the full untruncated result in memory. Fixed Windows auto-update failures that could leave claude.exe missing.
